integrity: Claims are presented as mathematical deductions and computational cross-checks, with no independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification restricted to synchronous three-colour threshold updates on loopless complete graphs. Gaussian law assumes iid uniform colours. The threshold-one case builds on earlier general-graph theory; historical priority against unindexed special-case literature is unresolved.
title: Complete-graph cyclic dominance: exact orbit census and an arithmetic critical window
